from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single provided paper regarding its citations."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the paper being parsed")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] | None = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that appear in this paper's reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates the extracted information from all provided papers."""
    papers: list[Paper]
